claims.quote: Might it be preferable to make m_block_template non-mutating? Do users of the interface even need the mutated template after submitting?

claims.author: ViniciusCestarii
claims.question: How was the latency of an immutable template benchmarked?
claims.quote: Could you share how you benchmarked this? I'd like to reproduce it and it would also be useful for measuring the libmultiprocess improvements later.

status_by.quote: Thanks @Sjors! I was able to reproduce it on my machine. I got similar results.

claims.status_note: author provided benchmark gist and reviewer reproduced results

claims.author: ViniciusCestarii
claims.quote: IMO 6ms or 2.5ms seems an acceptable cost for an immutable template, especially since it only applies after the miner itself finds a valid block and you've already identified ways to bring it down. Do
claims.request: Make the template immutable now rather than adding a temporary mutex, as 2.5ms to 6ms is an acceptable latency cost

status_by.quote: That said, I don’t feel strongly about. I am fine with it being a future follow up.

claims.status_note: reviewer dropped the suggestion, accepting it as a future follow up
